title: Purple Hammer Warrior
description: A dynamic full-body depiction of a female warrior with purple hair in mid-leap, wielding a massive purple warhammer with crackling white energy patterns. She wears a white and purple cropped top with tribal patterns, matching arm guards, baggy white pants with purple accents, and armored boots.
